Comment.value: Weathertop King -- placed, not spawned, so the Roll of the Fallen can see him. Paired with the Queen by wtop_royal.nss.
Weathertop Queen -- placed, not spawned. She heals the King below half health; kill her first and he grieves.

wtop_4key_door_in -- the inner half of the sealed pair. Same lock, same key (wtop_4key_whole), same AutoRemoveKey, same OnOpen (wtop_kdoor) as the outer door 6m west, and LinkedTo it both ways so the two are one crossing. wtop_kdoor swings and slams both halves together, so one key buys one crossing in either direction.
@nomapnote -- the destination is this same area, so a pin here would just read 'Weather Top's Hidden Court'.

Needs all 4 wtop key fragments to open.
Key is consumed on open
Stays open for 10 seconds, making creeking/mechanical noises and jittering every 2 second
After 10 second total door closes shut and relocks itself - players need to teleport to get out

Now also the outer half of a two-way transition to wtop_4key_door_in (the old CryptExit doorway just east); both doors open and slam in lockstep. 'Players need to teleport to get out' is now one of three exits -- the portal behind the thrones, a second key, or someone on the entrance side opening their own.
@nomapnote -- same-area hop, see the inner door.
Places an Area Transition in the Doorway (Similar to how a transition would appear after a Door is destroyed).
Throne - Good
Throne - Evil

wtop_portal -- the portal terrain feature behind the thrones, wired as an ordinary area transition back to the wtopcourt2wtop waypoint on Amon Sul, the same place the court's exit door lands. Covers world x 22-48, y 131-139 (tiles 2-4 of row 13); the south edge is held at y=131 so it cannot fire during the throne fight at y~124-125.

This is the default waypoint you may place to set a patrol path for a creature or NPC.
1. Create the creature and either use its current Tag or fill in a new one.
2. Place or make sure the WalkWayPoints() is within the body of the On Spawn script for the creature.
3. Place a series of waypoints along the route you wish the creature to walk.
4. Select all of the newly created waypoints and right click. Choose the Create Set option.
5. The waypoint set will have a set name of "WP_" + NPC Tag. Thus if an NPC with the Tag "Guard" will have a waypoint set called "WP_Guard". Note that Tags are case sensitive.

3. Place a series of waypoints along the route you wish the creature to walk.
4. Select all of the newly created waypoints and right click. Choose the Create Set option.
5. The waypoint set will have a set name of "WP_" + NPC Tag. Thus if an NPC with the Tag "Guard" will have a waypoint set called "WP_Guard". Note that Tags are case sensitive.
